name: trojan-heroes
about: Heroes of the Trojan War, of both sides: the Achaeans, and the Trojans with their allies

names.name: Achilles
names.note: Achaean: the strongest fighter of the Greeks, leader of the Myrmidons

names.name: Agamemnon
names.note: Achaean: king of Mycenae, leader of the Greek army

names.name: Menelaus
names.note: Achaean: king of Sparta, husband of Helen

names.name: Odysseus
names.note: Achaean: king of Ithaca, known for his cunning

names.name: Diomedes
names.note: Achaean: king of Argos, a bold fighter

names.name: Nestor
names.note: Achaean: the old king of Pylos, an adviser

names.name: Ajax the Great
names.note: Achaean: son of Telamon, the great defender of the ships

names.name: Ajax the Lesser
names.note: Achaean: leader of the Locrians, a fast runner

names.name: Idomeneus
names.note: Achaean: king of Crete

names.name: Meriones
names.note: Achaean: a Cretan, companion of Idomeneus

names.name: Patroclus
names.note: Achaean: friend of Achilles, killed by Hector

names.name: Philoctetes
names.note: Achaean: an archer with the bow of Heracles; he killed Paris

names.name: Neoptolemus
names.note: Achaean: son of Achilles, came to Troy late in the war

names.name: Teucer
names.note: Achaean: an archer, half-brother of Ajax the Great

names.name: Palamedes
names.note: Achaean: a clever hero, killed by Odysseus and Diomedes

names.name: Protesilaus
names.note: Achaean: the first Greek to land at Troy, and the first to fall

names.name: Machaon
names.note: Achaean: a healer, son of Asclepius

names.name: Podalirius
names.note: Achaean: a healer, brother of Machaon

names.name: Antilochus
names.note: Achaean: son of Nestor

names.name: Sthenelus
names.note: Achaean: companion of Diomedes

names.name: Menestheus
names.note: Achaean: leader of the Athenians

names.name: Acamas
names.note: Achaean: son of Theseus

names.name: Demophon
names.note: Achaean: son of Theseus, brother of Acamas

names.name: Agapenor
names.note: Achaean: leader of the Arcadians

names.name: Automedon
names.note: Achaean: charioteer of Achilles

names.name: Phoenix
names.note: Achaean: the old teacher of Achilles

names.name: Epeius
names.note: Achaean: the builder of the wooden horse

names.name: Eumelus
names.note: Achaean: son of Admetus, a fine charioteer

names.name: Leonteus
names.note: Achaean: a leader of the Lapiths

names.name: Polypoetes
names.note: Achaean: a leader of the Lapiths, with Leonteus

names.name: Meges
names.note: Achaean: leader of the men of Dulichium

names.name: Nireus
names.note: Achaean: a very handsome Greek, killed by Eurypylus

names.name: Thersites
names.note: Achaean: a soldier who mocked the kings, killed by Achilles

names.name: Hector
names.note: Trojan: eldest son of Priam, the first fighter of Troy

names.name: Paris
names.note: Trojan: son of Priam, who took Helen to Troy

names.name: Aeneas
names.note: Trojan: son of Aphrodite; he survived the fall of Troy

names.name: Priam
names.note: Trojan: the old king of Troy

names.name: Deiphobus
names.note: Trojan: son of Priam, killed by Menelaus

names.name: Helenus
names.note: Trojan: son of Priam and a seer; he survived

names.name: Troilus
names.note: Trojan: a young son of Priam, killed by Achilles

names.name: Polites
names.note: Trojan: son of Priam, killed by Neoptolemus

names.name: Lycaon
names.note: Trojan: son of Priam, killed by Achilles

names.name: Antenor
names.note: Trojan: an elder and adviser of Troy

names.name: Agenor
names.note: Trojan: son of Antenor

names.name: Iphidamas
names.note: Trojan: son of Antenor, killed by Agamemnon

names.name: Polydamas
names.note: Trojan: friend and adviser of Hector

names.name: Euphorbus
names.note: Trojan: he wounded Patroclus; killed by Menelaus

names.name: Cebriones
names.note: Trojan: charioteer of Hector, killed by Patroclus

names.name: Dolon
names.note: Trojan: a scout, killed by Odysseus and Diomedes

names.name: Alcathous
names.note: Trojan: son-in-law of Anchises, killed by Idomeneus

names.name: Simoisius
names.note: Trojan: a young fighter, killed by Ajax the Great

names.name: Sarpedon
names.note: Trojan ally: leader of the Lycians, son of Zeus

names.name: Glaucus
names.note: Trojan ally: a Lycian, friend of Sarpedon

names.name: Pandarus
names.note: Trojan ally: an archer who broke the truce

names.name: Memnon
names.note: Trojan ally: king of the Aethiopians, killed by Achilles

names.name: Rhesus
names.note: Trojan ally: king of Thrace, killed by Odysseus and Diomedes

names.name: Asteropaeus
names.note: Trojan ally: leader of the Paeonians, killed by Achilles

names.name: Cycnus
names.note: Trojan ally: son of Poseidon, killed by Achilles

names.name: Eurypylus
names.note: Trojan ally: son of Telephus, killed by Neoptolemus

names.name: Asius
names.note: Trojan ally: a leader from Arisbe

names.name: Hippothous
names.note: Trojan ally: leader of the Pelasgians, killed by Ajax the Great

names.name: Pylaemenes
names.note: Trojan ally: leader of the Paphlagonians, killed by Menelaus

names.name: Penthesilea
names.note: Trojan ally: queen of the Amazons, killed by Achilles

names.name: Antibrote
names.note: Trojan ally: an Amazon, killed by Achilles

names.name: Derinoe
names.note: Trojan ally: an Amazon, killed by Ajax the Lesser
